Summary
: This essay studies the Theory and Practice of Gati: A Sanskrit technical term translated to “gait” which refers to the “movement of a character on the stage”, as commonly employed in ancient Indian Theatrics and the Dramatic arts, also known as Natya-shastra. This thesis explores the history and evolution of Gati and also investigates how the various Gatis are employed in regional performance traditions.
